Create dialog offered Title, Description, Deadline, Priority select and prerequisite checkbox list. Created with title "QA Task Alpha", desc "Alpha description for QA", deadline 2026-09-20, High priority, prerequisite "Buy groceries"; card shows all: "QA Task Alpha / High / Alpha description for QA / Sep 20 / Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete".

Sort by Deadline order: Buy groceries (Aug 29/Tomorrow), Review (Aug 30), Submit final report (Sep 2), Dentist (Sep 4), Tax filing (Sep 11), QA Task Alpha (Sep 20), then QA Task Beta No Deadline (no date) last.

Sort by Priority yields: 4 High (QA Task Alpha, Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report), then 2 Medium (QA Task Beta, Schedule dentist appointment), then Low (Buy groceries).

Active tab shows only the 7 incomplete tasks with badge "7"; Completed tab shows only the 2 completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Organize desk) with badge "2". Switching back restores active-only list.

Cards show title + priority badge (High/Medium/Low); description and deadline shown when supplied (QA Task Beta with no description/deadline shows only title+Medium); blocked tasks show warning e.g. 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' / "2 prerequisites incomplete"; completed tasks render with line-through/muted styling while active tasks have none.

issue: Blocked task is fully uneditable — no way to change description or priority
actual: For blocked tasks (QA Task Alpha, Complete tax filing, Submit final report) the edit button is rendered with the disabled attribute (verified via DOM: btns[1].disabled === true). Clicking the button, its wrapper span, and the task title/card opens no dialog ([role=dialog] stays absent), so description and priority cannot be modified while blocked. Expected: an edit form limited to description + priority.

evidence: Single incomplete prerequisite shows named warning: 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' (Complete tax filing) and 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete' (QA Task Alpha); multiple shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" (Submit final report).
Hovering "2 prerequisites incomplete" on Submit final report opens a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Review project proposal – pending" and "Complete tax filing – pending".

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray "6,4") join dependent tasks, each wrapped in a g.pointer-events-auto tooltip trigger with a transparent 16px-wide hit path. Hovering the connector at (640,310) (where the hit path is the topmost element per elementFromPoint) set data-state="delayed-open" and rendered tooltip: "Dependency Chain — QA Task Alpha pending, Buy groceries pending".

Assigned two prerequisites (Schedule dentist appointment + Buy groceries) to "QA Task Beta Edited" via edit dialog; after save the card shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" and is rendered blocked. Single-prereq assignment at creation also retained ("Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete").

Chain built: QA Chain C → QA Task Beta Edited → Buy groceries. Editing "Buy groceries" prerequisite list omits itself, its direct dependents (QA Task Alpha, QA Task Beta Edited) and its indirect dependent (QA Chain C); only non-cycle tasks (Review project proposal, Schedule dentist, Complete tax filing, Organize desk, Reply to client emails, Submit final report) are offered.

Clicking the circle button on active task "Buy groceries" moved counts 8 active/2 completed → 7 active/3 completed; it disappeared from Active list and now appears in the Completed view with strikethrough styling.

While "Buy groceries" was incomplete, dependent "QA Task Alpha" showed the warning badge 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete', a dashed connector, and had its complete-circle and edit buttons disabled=true. After completing Buy groceries, Alpha shows "1 prerequisite completed" and its complete button became enabled (disabled=false).

"QA Task Alpha" (prereq: Buy groceries incomplete) had its completion control disabled (button.disabled === true), so it could not be completed. After completing "Buy groceries", the same control became enabled (disabled === false) and the card switched to "1 prerequisite completed".

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked, with no way to fix it
actual: "QA Task Alpha" (prereq: Buy groceries) was completed while its prerequisite was complete. Reopening "Buy groceries" from the Completed view succeeded with no warning/prompt (counts 6 active/4 completed → 7 active/3 completed). QA Task Alpha stayed in the Completed view with strikethrough AND now simultaneously shows the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete'. Its completion toggle and edit button are both disabled=true, so the task is stuck completed-and-blocked and cannot even be reopened by the user.

evidence: After completing "Buy groceries" it was not deleted — it persisted in the Completed view (3 completed) with its title, description and deadline intact, and clicking its toggle reopened it back into the Active list (7 active, 3 completed).

Edited unblocked task "QA Task Beta No Deadline": title→"QA Task Beta Edited", description→"Beta edited description", deadline→Sep 5, priority Medium→Low, added 2 prerequisites; all changes persisted on the card after Save Changes. Deleting "QA Chain C" removed it immediately (7→6 active) and it is absent from both the Active and Completed views.
